claim_limits: A historical allow receipt does not prove authority is live now.
Fail-closed on missing status infrastructure is not the same as portable current-standing proof.
This does not claim AGT lacks revocation; ExternalJWKSProvider is explicitly tested as a strong online revocation control.
This does not claim OpenLine discovers hidden revocations globally. A receiver must receive a newer signed Wallet bundle; bundle expiry and monotonic head rules bound what it may accept.
No result generalizes beyond the pinned AGT and Wallet revisions and the tested ordinary paths.

constraints.strong_agt_status_configuration: ExternalJWKSProvider uses a trusted endpoint with revocation_cache_ttl_seconds=0 so AGT is not made to lose on its default cache window.

7a_historical_receipt_external_verificat.pass: An independent verifier that imports no AGT code validates the pinned signer, receipt signatures, payload hashes, and hash chain.
7a_historical_receipt_external_verificat.question: Can a past AGT governance receipt be verified outside AGT?

7b_current_live_authority_outside_contro.nonpass_is_not: Fail-closed when a live status endpoint disappears is safe behavior, but it is not portable proof of which authority is current.
7b_current_live_authority_outside_contro.pass: Ordinary AGT output supplies a portable authenticated freshness/standing artifact sufficient to distinguish current post-revocation state from an older valid state without querying the governance status source being exited.
7b_current_live_authority_outside_contro.question: After a newer revocation state exists, can an independent receiver authenticate which authority state is current after the governance status source/control plane exits?

model_exit.pass: Both provider-labelled workers execute the same allowed job and produce a valid receipt chain.
model_exit.question: Can the same governed logical job continue through AGT when the model/provider label changes, without changing the governance rule?

online_revocation_control.pass: With revocation cache TTL forced to zero, valid token passes, revoked kid is denied, and status-source transport failure fails closed.
online_revocation_control.question: Does AGT correctly enforce current revocation while its ordinary live status source exists?

unsafe_timing.absence_rule: If the tested AGT path exposes no comparable temporal admission/protection claim, record NO_COMPARABLE_PROTECTION_CLAIM_SURFACE. Do not call that a security defect.
unsafe_timing.agt_pass: A comparable ordinary AGT admission surface refuses a revocation-protection claim because the supported bound exceeds the consequence horizon.

outcome_rules.AGT_CURRENT_STANDING_PORTABLE_TEMPORAL_A: AGT passes portable current-standing exit but exposes no comparable temporal protection-admission surface.
outcome_rules.AGT_MATCHES_PORTABLE_CURRENT_AUTHORITY: AGT passes model exit, 7a, portable 7b after status-source exit, and comparable unsafe-timing refusal.
outcome_rules.AGT_MODEL_EXIT_OFFLINE_RECEIPT_PASS_CURR: AGT passes model exit and offline historical receipt verification; its live status path handles revocation safely, but no portable authenticated current-standing artifact survives status-source exit.
outcome_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_AGT_ENVIRONMENT: Pinned source cannot be checked out/loaded or comparator-scoped upstream receipt tests fail.
outcome_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_AGT_SEMANTICS: Observed behavior does not match a preregistered branch.
outcome_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_OPENLINE_BASELINE: Current pinned Wallet baseline fails its already-frozen behaviors.

pins.note: The pinned AGT monorepo main CI run was not globally green. This experiment does not treat that as comparator evidence; it reruns the selected upstream receipt tests and classifies setup/import/test failure as environment-inconclusive.

question: Can Microsoft AGT preserve independently usable current authority across both a model-provider exit and a governance-control-plane/status-source exit, while refusing to claim revocation protection when the timing budget cannot beat consequence?
